# Play — Counting Stars

- SudokuPad: [Counting Stars on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Counting Stars on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The between lines and sandwich sums are native f-puzzles constraints. f-puzzles has no counting-circle entry, so every star
is also a **cosmetic** navy circle; the apps won't enforce the counting rule (the answer check still works). The between
lines draw their own circles at their ends, on the same cells. I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks
off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

Circles (15): r1c5, r3c3, r3c7, r6c4, r5c5, r4c6, r9c3, r9c8, r1c2, r2c9, r4c9, r6c9, r3c1, r5c2, r8c6.

Between lines: r1c5–r2c4–r3c3; r1c5–r2c6–r3c7; r3c3–r4c3–r5c3–r6c4; r3c7–r4c7–r4c6; r6c4–r5c5–r4c6; r6c4–r7c4–r8c3–r9c3; r4c6–r5c6–r6c6–r7c7–r8c8–r9c8; r3c3–r2c2–r1c2; r3c7–r3c8–r2c9; r2c9–r3c9–r4c9; r4c9–r5c9–r6c9.

Sandwich sums: right of row 2: 33; above column 9: 31; right of row 5: 11; left of row 3: 2.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
